name: pr-act-60-incentives
description: Puerto Rico Act 60 (Incentives Code, Act 60-2019) decrees for individual resident investors and for export services, tax year 2026. Covers who can apply, the 0 percent and 4 percent rates on interest and dividends, the 0 percent, 4 percent and 5 percent capital-gain rules, the split between applications filed by 31 December 2026 and applications filed on or after 1 January 2027, the 4 percent tax on export-service net income, the base-period limit, the USD 10,000 annual contribution, the USD 5,000 annual report charge, the principal-residence purchase, and the compliance-report dates. Ordinary brackets stay in the individual and company skills. Federal residence tests stay in the federal residence skill. Trigger on "Act 60", "Ley 60", "Act 22", "Act 20", "resident investor", "inversionista residente", "export services decree", "4 percent Puerto Rico".
